note: Round 28 (Claude, 2026-10-03): how monsters fight, so no two fights are the same. Robert: 'keep working on the game, build it out, make it more diverse'. Enemy.gd reads this. A monster's STYLE comes from enemies.json "style" if it has one, else from words in its name, else from its id; on floor 2 and deeper a few in each pack take a VARIANT style, and from floor 3 a few are ELITE with one or two AFFIXES. Floor 1 stays plain (it teaches the basics). Bosses keep their own way of fighting and grow ENRAGED at half health.

ranged.name: Slinger
ranged.desc: keeps its distance and throws -- close in, or step aside from the shot

charger.name: Charging
charger.desc: lowers its head, then runs you down in a straight line -- step out of the way

guardian.name: Shieldbearer
guardian.desc: turns blows from the front -- go round it, or use your arts

skulker.name: Lurking
skulker.desc: unseen until it's close; its first blow is the worst

swarmer.name: Brood
swarmer.desc: never alone -- it brings its young

mender.name: Mending
mender.desc: heals the others -- kill it first

swift.name: Swift
swift.desc: faster on its feet and with its blows

venomous.name: Venomous
venomous.desc: its hits poison you for a few seconds

vampiric.name: Vampiric
vampiric.desc: heals from the blood it draws

frenzied.name: Frenzied
frenzied.desc: the more you hurt it, the faster it gets

splitting.name: Splitting
splitting.desc: breaks into two lesser ones when it falls

warding.name: Warding
warding.desc: your arts' staggers, slows and burns hold on it half as long

thunderous.name: Thunderous
thunderous.desc: stamps the ground every few seconds -- watch for the ring, and step out

gilded.name: Gilded
gilded.desc: carries far more than it should

blinking.name: Blinking
blinking.desc: flickers -- then steps out of the air behind you; turn when it fades

volatile.name: Volatile
volatile.desc: its last breath bursts -- get clear of the ring when it falls

commanding.name: Commanding
commanding.desc: its shout drives the others near it to hit harder and move faster -- kill it first

lines: Your stance is wrong. Let me show you.
The elders say you're promising. I'd like to see that.
Cross hands with me -- I'll go easy. At first.
Another wanderer with a sword. Show me it isn't for show.
My senior says I'm not ready for the tower. I'll prove her wrong on you.
They talk about you in the hall. I'd rather find out myself.
